extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from XML/PDF prose, Figure 4/5/6, OA package images, and supplementary DOCX tables/figures. Direct mechanism is limited to model-membrane DSC evidence; antibacterial membrane-disruption language is kept as inferred context.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: DP1 directly perturbs model membrane thermotropic behavior in DSC assays, with stronger effects on negatively charged DMPC/DMPG vesicles than on DMPC alone.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: DP1 and comparator N-15 CATH-2 in model membrane vesicles
direct_assay_types: differential scanning calorimetry with DMPC and DMPC/DMPG multilamellar vesicles
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is model-membrane biophysical evidence, not a live-cell pore-formation assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: DP1 adopts and retains helical structure in membrane-mimicking environments and micelle simulations, supporting membrane-interaction competence.
mechanism_claims.limitations: MD and CD/solvent structure evidence supports mechanism context but does not by itself prove bacterial membrane disruption.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper interprets DP1 antibacterial activity as consistent with charge/hydrophobicity-mediated bacterial membrane interaction; this remains an inferred mechanism from MIC, structure, and model-membrane evidence.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: DP1, DP2, DP3, and N-15 CATH-2 structure-activity relationship

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=8:Antimicrobial activities against Gram-positive and Gram-negative organisms

mechanism_claims.limitations: No local primary assay directly measures pore formation or bacterial membrane permeabilization in live bacteria.
